## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any checks you could not run. For behavior changes,
include a regression case; for documented commands, try the README smoke.

## Compatibility

Describe any changed policy, receipt, CLI, dependency or data-flow behavior.
Write "No behavior change" when appropriate. Do not include private keys,
credentials or customer receipts.
